comment:
this is *the* worst game ive ever had the misfortune of playing - after 3 hours spent trying to decipher the appalling rules (the updated ones werent really any better), staring at the abysmal artwork and trying to make sense of the ridiculous grammar and spelling (health is spelt as healht everywhere, throughout the rules and even on the cards)
We eventually gave up on this overcomplicated game (which at teh end of the day turns out to basically be a variation on cluedo) and i am planning on burning my copy to try and forget that painful evening.

If i could rate it negatively i would it really is that bad, how it has such a good rating is beyond me.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS
